translations.web: The pillars will be broken in pieces. All those who work for hire will be grieved in soul.
translations.bsb: The workers in cloth will be dejected, and all the hired workers will be sick at heart.
translations.kjv: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices and ponds for fish.
translations.asv: And the pillars of Egypt shall be broken in pieces; all they that work for hire shall be grieved in soul.
